method.inputs: Installed visible driver JSON-line commands only; ordinary deploy and visible Deploy Again button; keyboard, mouse, screenshots, facility map and visible HUD.
method.observations: Screenshots opened and inspected through view_image. No source, tests, old reviews, hidden state, arbitrary evaluation, solution lookup or additional mission pass used.
method.graphics: Driver reported software-WebGL fallback enabled; renderer not certified.
confounds: Paused synthetic play, not continuous human or hardware input. Each action normally photographs live then pauses with Escape; this creates ample planning time.
Browser-timed synthetic DOM input and scheduling can extend waits: observed examples include requested 700 ms taking 782 ms, 1000 taking 1152 ms, 800 taking 944 ms, and 2900 taking 3033 ms.

Photographs took roughly 24–391 ms and live simulation can advance during capture; e.g. attempt1-east-approach screenshot health 79 versus beforePause health 83. Held ADS captures were explicitly used and movement/fire released where appropriate.

Mouse aim was calibrated by visible photographs; several honest misses, especially breacher shots and post-Shift firing, were reviewer aiming/position errors and do not independently prove weapon defects.

One attempt-2 extraction command was rejected with Invalid relative mouse delta for x=2500. It is preserved in the action log, then retried using two x=1250 steps. This is a driver limit, not a game defect.
No audio, human enjoyment, controller, hardware frame pacing or GPU certification assessed.

attempts.tactics: Critical rifle ADS shot on entry Warden, west side route, tried pump breacher fire/reload, recovered west then Heart then east memories, sprint/Shift and attempted vault, attacked Custodian coils.
attempts.progress: All three memories recovered. Coil 3 OFF; coil 2 last photographed at 90%, coil 1 at 100%. Died while attempting remaining coils.
attempts.honestFailures: Breacher fired and consumed ammo without an elimination; rifle shots also missed. Multiple recovery holds began outside the receiver reach. Shift moved position and invalidated a follow-up aim. Vault attempt did not clear the encountered black barrier.

attempts.start: Clicked visible DEPLOY AGAIN button after attempt 1 terminal screen.
attempts.tactics: More deliberate rifle ADS photographs and weak-point fire; west, Heart, east recovery route; attacked all three coils, returned toward extraction and held the deck.
attempts.progress: All three memories recovered, all three Custodian coils OFF, uplink released. Entered deck; last preterminal photograph showed 14% uplink. Died during a stationary timed hold.
attempts.honestFailures: Some east contact shots missed; several obstacles and receiver holds needed repositioning. Took severe damage near Custodian while focused on coils. Did not complete extraction or establish a maximum upload progress between photographs.

weaponHandMaterialHandling.rifle: Dark angular receiver, cyan accent, open rectangular optic, barrel components and pale support glove are readable. ADS centers the weapon and provided a usable sight picture for repeat critical hits. Firing consumed ammo rapidly; reload lowered the weapon, showed Reloading then Weapon ready, and restored magazine after waiting.
weaponHandMaterialHandling.breacher: Distinct broader, long-barrel body with two prominent yellow sight posts, six-round magazine and separate reserve. Tried ADS, sustained trigger fire, switching and reload. Ammo fell from six to four, later three; reload restored six. No breacher kill confirmed.
weaponHandMaterialHandling.hands: Visible pale glove/fingers at support grip and simple sleeves. In inspected stills these read as coarse segmented geometry; no convincing detailed skin/fabric, sophisticated finger articulation or intricate manipulation was established. No dedicated animation capture, so cannot judge every reload/pump frame.
weaponHandMaterialHandling.materials: Weapons and hands have clean broad shaded surfaces and limited fine detail. Concrete shows cracks/mottling, wet ground carries warm reflections, rain and cyan lighting establish a cohesive storm station. Repeated block props and simple robot bodies remain visibly prototype scale/detail.
weaponHandMaterialHandling.handlingLimits: Two ordinary missions only. No frame-by-frame animation study, audio judgement, controller comparison, exhaustive weapon mechanics, damage model certification, successful extraction or later content coverage.

strengths.observation: Strong cyan/amber storm palette, reflective floor, rain and central circular relay landmark give the facility a consistent visual identity.
Objective names, world signs, distance readouts and paused facility map made the three-memory route understandable without external instructions.
Rifle optic weak-point shots visibly rewarded precision with critical elimination feedback; second attempt improved to three combat kills before boss completion.
Numbered coils, OFF states, armored/open-window labels and uplink-release message clearly expose boss progress and objective transition.
Terminal results and visible retry worked, preserving an understandable mission result.

defectsAndFriction.observation: Navigation repeatedly stopped at low cover, bench-like props and boss geometry; some obstacles were legible only after a no-progress movement batch. The vault attempt at the black barrier did not clear it. This cost mission exposure and repeated adjustments.
defectsAndFriction.limit: Collision intent and exact vault eligibility cannot be diagnosed from visible play alone.

defectsAndFriction.observation: MOVE CLOSER at roughly 3.1–3.5 M and solid receiver bodies led to repeated unsuccessful E holds around the recovery floor ring. Prompt is clear, but interaction placement felt exacting under fire.

Late combat stacked incoming damage from offscreen enemies while attention was on coil shutters. Direction chevrons and recent-fire text help, but I lost large chunks of health without visually identifying each attacker; still screenshots limit a stronger attribution.

Weapons, gloves, robot enemies, worktables and large flat walls retain broad block forms and simple materials; inspected hand/weapon presentation lacks the detailed authored surface treatment expected for AAA readiness.

Objective, boss status, instructional announcements, damage indicators, mini-map and textual feeds can compete for attention in combat. Small monospaced text is useful but less immediately readable than the primary HUD.

ratings.scale: 0–10, independent observed vertical-slice judgement; no target score assumed.
ratings.rationale: A coherent complete mission loop, readable objectives and precision/boss feedback; route friction, crowded threat communication and simple assets/hand detail reduce polish. Neither attempt completed extraction, and synthetic pauses constrain claims about continuous play.
